Military history dates back to ancient civilizations. Empires like Rome, Persia, and China built powerful armies to conquer and defend territories. The evolution of weaponry, strategies, and leadership from swords to nuclear weapons has significantly shaped global politics and borders. Major milestones include the Napoleonic Wars, World Wars I & II, and the Cold War era, which intensified arms races and shaped modern militarization.
